title: Cart accepts negative item quantities and calculates a negative total
reason: Checkpoint assertion failed: "the cart Total is not a negative amount"

verdict.title: Cart accepts negative item quantities and calculates a negative total
verdict.oneLiner: The cart accepted a quantity of -3 for the Ash Glaze Mug and displayed a total of $-84.00.
verdict.rootCause: The cart does not block a negative quantity or restore the item quantity to 1. It uses the negative value to calculate the line item, cart total, and header count.
verdict.suggestion: Reject quantities below 1 on update, show a clear validation message, keep the existing valid quantity, and prevent negative values from affecting the header count or totals.
